exact_noop.equation: correction=lambda*g*delta_v; v_prime = v exactly if Phase4V is off or correction is exactly zero, else normalize(v+correction)
exact_noop.implementation_rule: Use an explicit identity branch/torch.where for exact-zero correction; never renormalize v in a no-op case, so lambda=0, g=0, and delta_v=0 reproduce the bit-identical Phase2B feature.

gradient_ownership.dynamic_text: not constructed or consumed by the Phase4V path
gradient_ownership.legacy_router_factor_act: frozen/not executed/absent in the Phase4V path
gradient_ownership.main_task_to_conditional_core: allowed after activation through c_I -> FiLM controller -> delta_v
gradient_ownership.main_task_to_phase2b: allowed through unchanged predictor and v_prime
gradient_ownership.spatial_gate: detached before multiplication; Phase4V cannot alter g

how.role: one shared lightweight visual residual; no attention, patch classifier, Router, or experts

predictor_contract.unchanged: Phase2B text features, DFG weights/logic, normal-vs-abnormal predictor, and loss remain unchanged; only its visual-token input may become v_prime after activation.

provenance.precision: strict FP32; TF32 off; AMP off

residual_monitoring.safety_rule: Stop before training if correction norm becomes comparable to base feature norm; no lambda sweep is permitted.

what.role: one image-level CoPS normal-vs-abnormal state contrast; no base posterior or patch gate enters this code
what.source: ConditionalSemanticCore over multi-level seg_tokens_pre_l2 with separate normal/abnormal prototype queries

where.role: per-patch local anomaly probability; WHERE only
where.source: ACDCLIP.vision_text_fusion_gate_seg on original seg_tokens with unchanged Phase2B text and DFG
